SUBJECT / SCENE In an Ancient Jungle Morning Setting, a long-abandoned jungle city plaza with cracked statues and vine-covered arches. Large readable terrain masses first, with deep environmental layering and strong spatial separation between foreground foliage, mid jungle structures, and distant canopy silhouettes. Light should clearly define major structural planes while allowing gentle atmospheric mist to separate depth layers and enhance spatial readability without obscuring primary forms. MOOD Sense of ancient discovery, untouched history, and quiet natural majesty.
